value.rationale: The motion of finite Curie--Weiss Lee--Yang zeros is itself the object of a dedicated theorem in the closest source. The result turns its qualitative zero-temperature limit into an explicit spectral/energetic law: the one-spin-flip gap controls the universal leading decay, the two-spin-flip sector controls the next scale, and the n=4 central-sector degeneracy changes the coefficient. This is a natural structural sharpening of a named zero-motion problem, not an arbitrary parameter slice or numerical increment.
